# Belgium Cleaning Facilities (BCF)

> Belgium Cleaning Facilities (BCF) is a professional B2B cleaning company based in Londerzeel, Belgium, active across the whole country; its manager has worked in cleaning since 1998. It cleans windows and facades at height (including reverse-osmosis pure-water cleaning), industrial floors, warehouses, car parks and commercial buildings for businesses. Workers are VCA certified. Businesses only: no private individuals. Free quotes, answered within 24 business hours. Languages: French, Dutch, English.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Belgium Cleaning Facilities SRL (BCF) — company number / VAT: BE 0704.995.703
- Manager's experience in the sector: since 1998
- Address: Kasteelstraat 16A, 1840 Londerzeel, Belgium
- Phone: +32 478 47 08 59 and +32 486 09 16 06
- Email: info@belcleanfac.be
- Service area: all of Belgium (Brussels, Flanders, Wallonia)
- Safety: workers hold VCA certificates (Safety Checklist Contractors); aerial lifts inspected by Vinçotte
- Customers: companies and professionals only — industry, logistics, hotels, higher education, car dealerships, property and facility managers
- Subcontractor for major cleaning groups: GOM, Vebego, Group F
- Named references: Hotel Wiltcher's (Brussels), Aston Martin Zaventem, VUB, KU Leuven, Van Mossel, SONOCO

## Services
- Window and facade cleaning at height: telescopic poles, truck-mounted lift, scissor lift, aerial platforms; frame cleaning, gentle facade sandblasting (IBIX), roof moss removal, graffiti removal
- Reverse-osmosis (pure water) window cleaning: demineralised water, detergent-free, streak-free, from the ground
- Industrial floor and large-surface cleaning: warehouses, production halls, car parks, scrubber-dryers and high-pressure equipment
- Building maintenance: offices, student residences, museums, event venues, post-construction cleaning
